limiterDetail: Main limiter: a combination of wind and rain. ESE wind runs 10–13 kt this morning on Tara, Turda, Decabobo, Ciron and Alava (peak ~9 AM), with showers ~1.4 mm/h from 9 AM to noon on Coron, Culion and Galoc. Currents are calm all day except a 6–10 PM pickup at Decabaitot (1.0 kt), Tara and Turda (0.8 kt).

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR · nothing active for Calamian / MIMAROPA (latest entries Mon ~5:30 AM PHT are gale advisories for Central Luzon, CALABARZON and Western Visayas only)

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since yesterday afternoon
items: Tue 13 slipped back to MARGINAL → NORMAL, softening. Rain went up to ~10.4 mm (was ~7.3 mm). The supply recovery now starts Wednesday , not Tuesday.
Sat 17 dropped to MARGINAL and is now the worst day of the week (11 kt, gusts 17). It was GOOD yesterday.
Today (Mon) is a bit better than feared: rain ~10.2 mm (was ~15.9 mm heavy), wind 9.7 kt. Shortage risk stays MILD , now Mon–Tue with another dip Sat. Wed 14 is the new best day (3.9 kt, gusts 9).

shortageRisk: No surge. Shortage risk MILD Mon → Tue , with another mild dip around Sat. Supply should be thinnest Tuesday, refilling from late Wednesday.

bestWindow.headline: Tonight ~6–8 PM (west and south) · Tue ~3–5 AM (all)
details: ~6–8 PM tonight: Coron, Culion, Galoc, Linapacan, Nangalao, Cabunlawan and Ciron are nearly dry (≤0.1 mm/h), wind 4–7 kt, currents ≤0.6 kt. Skip Decabaitot, Tara and Turda then, as currents hit 0.8–1.0 kt.
Tue ~3–5 AM: calmest stretch on every ground, wind 3–6 kt, currents ≤0.6 kt, only light showers. Galoc and Coron are best (3.3–3.6 kt). Avoid this morning's 8–11 AM on the east grounds.
